title: pvNetCDFMPASreader
body:
## pvNetCDFMPASreader

Reads one MPAS (Model for Prediction Across Scales) NetCDF file on a global unstructured Voronoi mesh and builds its dual grid as an unstructured grid: MPAS cell variables become point data and vertex variables become cell data. By default it shows vertical level 0 on a sphere as ocean data; options give a multilayer view, a lat/lon projection or atmospheric layering. Edge-centred data and regional (planar) domains are not supported, and it is not a parallel reader.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Additional dimensions (vertical level, tracer index) are fixed to one index per dimension; set ExtraDimensionIndices to choose the slice, or ShowMultilayerView to see all levels.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `NetCDFMPASreader`. Identity: `sources/MPASReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrayStatus` | This property lists which NetCDF dual-grid cell variables to load. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `CenterLongitude` | This property specifies where the center will be viewed for a lat/lon projection. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `ExtraDimensionIndices` | Fixes the index of each additional NetCDF dimension of the selected variables (any dimension other than Time, nCells and nVertices, e.g. nVertLevels or a tracer dimension), so one slice is loaded. Give a flat list of [dimension name, index] pairs, with zero-based indices written as strings, e.g. ["nVertLevels", "5"]. In multilayer view the dimension named by VerticalDimension is read in full and its index is ignored. Complete tuples of 2 values. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the file name to read. It should be an MPAS format NetCDF file ending in .nc. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `IsAtmosphere` | This property indicates whether data is atmospheric. Checking this ensures the vertical levels will go up away from the sphere instead of down towards the center. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `LayerThickness` | This property specifies how thick the layer should be if viewing the data in multilayer view. Each layer corresponds to a vertical level. A good starting point is 100,000 for the spherical view and 10 for the lat/lon projection. Click on -Z after applying this change, since the scale may change drastically. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `PointArrayStatus` | This property lists which NetCDF dual-grid point variables to load. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ProjectLatLon` | This property indicates whether to view the data in the lat/lon projection. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ShowMultilayerView` | This property indicates whether to show multiple layers in one view, with each vertical level having the same thickness, specified by the layer thickness slider. For ocean data, the layers correspond to data at vertical level whose number increases towards the center of the sphere. For atmospheric data, the layers correspond to data at vertical levels increasing away from the center. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `UseDimensionedArrayNames` | This property ensures that the dimension info is always shown in the ParaView GUI. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `VerticalDimension` | Name of the NetCDF dimension that represents vertical levels; the multilayer view (ShowMultilayerView) stacks one layer per index of this dimension. Change it for variables on another vertical dimension, such as interface levels (nVertLevelsP1 in MPAS files). | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvNetCDFMPASreader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
